description: Move a Goal right before or after another Goal, so the Roadmap lists the work in the order it should happen. Give exactly one of before and after. The dashboard lists the Goals that need the Developer (things to try, steps to check, questions) in this order too, so put the one they should check first in front.

after.description: The ID of the Goal to move it behind.

before.description: The ID of the Goal to move it in front of.

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

name: move_goal
title: Move Goal
